description: MCP Server Configuration - Fixed Salesforce MCP Disconnect Issue

notes: This Salesforce MCP configuration has been disabled because:
1. This is a static portfolio website with no Salesforce integration needed
2. The 'demo-org' was not a valid authenticated Salesforce org
3. To re-enable, authenticate with Salesforce CLI first using: sf org login web
4. Then update the configuration below with your actual org alias

how_to_fix_salesforce_mcp.step1: Authenticate with Salesforce CLI: sf org login web --alias my-org
how_to_fix_salesforce_mcp.step2: Update the 'YOUR_ORG_ALIAS_HERE' in this config with your org alias
how_to_fix_salesforce_mcp.step3: Set 'disabled: false' to enable the MCP server
how_to_fix_salesforce_mcp.step4: Restart Claude Code to apply changes
how_to_fix_salesforce_mcp.alternative: If you don't need Salesforce integration, leave it disabled
